text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi was doing distance runs 
on the training track.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I can still keep running!
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If you're saying that, Trainer, it must 
mean any more would be too much of a 
strain, right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll go do some cool-down 
exercises then!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Food, yummy food~♪ You gotta eat well and 
have a balanced diet, right!
choice_data_list: With today's menu, dessert would be—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
An orange! That's perfect for recovering 
from fatigue, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm starting to understand what I 
should eat to stay healthy!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: You're in a good mood, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm in great spirits, and in tip-top 
shape!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I don't tire out as easily lately, and 
I've been able to pay closer attention to 
my health in all sorts of ways.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
This is all thanks to you, Trainer! You 
taught me my limits and how to manage my 
physical condition!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my absolute best so that all the 
support I've received doesn't go to waste!
choice_data_list:
That's also thanks to your hard work, 
Tsuyoshi

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You really think so!? Thank you so much! 
All right, Tsuyoshi's gonna run with all 
she's got, woohoo!
